models.name: NOAA GFS
models.purpose: Initial public rainfall, temperature and wind baseline.
models.data_license: NOAA NODD open data; attribution requested
models.access: Public GRIB2; preserve cycle version, interval and publication timestamps.
models.grid: Select documented 0.25 degree delivery grid; delivery grid is not native resolution.

models.name: NOAA GEFS
models.purpose: Initial public probabilistic rainfall baseline.
models.data_license: NOAA NODD open data; attribution requested
models.access: Operational and GEFS v12 retrospective archives are separate.
notes: GEFS v12 2000-2019 reforecasts have 5 daily members and an 11-member weekly extension, not operational member counts.

models.name: ECMWF IFS control
models.purpose: Independent NWP baseline after matching the available common evaluation period.
models.data_license: CC-BY-4.0 plus ECMWF Terms of Use
models.access: Open-data control forecast; select type=cf and pin cycle. Older archives may need registration.
notes: Control, HRES and ensemble products must not be silently interchanged.

models.name: ECMWF IFS ENS
models.purpose: Probabilistic NWP comparator and later expert.
models.data_license: CC-BY-4.0 plus ECMWF Terms of Use
models.access: Open-data ensemble; archive coverage and member inventory must be audited.

models.name: ECMWF AIFS Single
models.purpose: Later AI rainfall, temperature and wind expert with checkpoint-specific training embargo.
models.data_license: CC-BY-4.0 plus ECMWF Terms of Use
notes: Version 2 implemented 2026-05-12. Native atmospheric resolution approximately 31 km; six-hour steps.

models.name: ECMWF AIFS ENS
models.purpose: Later probabilistic AI comparator after archive and training-cutoff review.
models.data_license: CC-BY-4.0 plus ECMWF Terms of Use
notes: Provider documents v2 from 2026-05-12 and ensemble archives from July 2025; this entry does not infer the v2 checkpoint training cutoff.

models.name: GraphCast Operational
models.purpose: Initial public AI rainfall expert using NOAA AIWP hindcasts.
models.data_license: NOAA AIWP provider states open data without usage restrictions
notes: NOAA documents six-hour precipitation totals and archive start January 2022.
NOAA package versions and GFS/IFS initializations must be tracked separately from checkpoint identity.

models.name: Pangu-Weather
models.purpose: Initial public temperature and wind expert; unavailable for native rainfall.
models.data_license: NOAA AIWP provider states open data without usage restrictions
notes: No native precipitation field. A separately trained diagnostic pipeline would be a distinct source.
NOAA documents reforecasts from October 2020; this is not a verified checkpoint cutoff. Weight licensing remains unverified here.

models.name: FourCastNet v2-small
models.purpose: Initial public temperature and wind expert; no native rainfall.
models.data_license: NOAA AIWP provider states open data without usage restrictions
notes: The NOAA v2-small variable inventory does not include precipitation. Do not transfer precipitation capability from FourCastNet v1 or another checkpoint.

models.name: FourCastNet 3
models.purpose: Optional probabilistic temperature and wind research expert.
notes: The published model does not include a native precipitation output; the paper identifies it as future diagnostic work.
Reported global benchmarks are not local India skill evidence.

models.name: Aurora original weather checkpoint
models.purpose: Optional surface temperature and wind research expert.
notes: Original default weather surface channels are 2t, 10u, 10v and msl; no native rain channel.

models.name: Aurora 1.5
models.purpose: Optional expanded-variable deterministic expert.
notes: July 2026 release adds precipitation and hourly output. Audit the precise checkpoint, accumulation metadata and cutoff before use.

models.name: Aurora 1.5 ensemble
models.purpose: Optional ensemble extension; do not reuse original Aurora's capabilities.

models.name: GenCast
models.purpose: Optional probabilistic expert evaluated at native accumulation intervals.
notes: Research checkpoint is distinct from the Operational <2022 checkpoint.
Native 12-hour rainfall totals must not be split into fabricated six-hour totals.

models.name: WeatherNext 2
models.purpose: Optional open-weight/managed ensemble expert after exact product review.
models.data_license: Historical served data: CC-BY-4.0; real-time and managed inference have separate provider terms
notes: Released weights and commercial served data are different access routes and must not share assumed licensing or versions.

models.name: WeatherNext 3
models.purpose: Optional managed ensemble product; no assumed local checkpoint or archive entitlement.
models.data_license: Historical served data: CC-BY-4.0; real-time data and managed services have separate terms
notes: Provider describes hourly initializations, variable-dependent resolution and 15-day ensembles. Exact fields, account access, cutoff and historical availability need audit.

models.name: NeuralGCM standard
models.purpose: Atmospheric research comparator; not a direct precipitation expert.
notes: Standard checkpoints do not directly predict precipitation. Atmospheric temperature/wind are not automatically canonical 2m temperature/10m wind.
External ocean forcing and any surface diagnostic pipeline must be documented.

models.name: NeuralGCM precipitation checkpoint
models.purpose: Coarse-grid precipitation research comparator; not an India local-resolution substitute.
notes: Precipitation-specific checkpoint; documented cumulative precipitation is intended for intervals of at least six hours.
Any rate integration must be explicit and retain interval endpoints.

models.name: NCUM global
models.purpose: India-domain optional comparator after provider access and version audit.
models.access: Provider charts do not establish permission or availability of machine-readable forecast archives.
notes: The cited configuration is historical. Current grid, cycles, members, license and archive remain unverified.

models.name: NCUM regional
models.purpose: India-domain optional comparator after provider access and version audit.
models.access: Provider charts do not establish permission or availability of machine-readable forecast archives.
notes: The cited configuration is historical. Current grid, cycles, members, license and archive remain unverified.

models.name: NEPS global
models.purpose: India-domain optional comparator after provider access and version audit.
models.access: Provider charts do not establish permission or availability of machine-readable forecast archives.
notes: The cited configuration is historical. Current grid, cycles, members, license and archive remain unverified.

models.name: NEPS regional
models.purpose: India-domain optional comparator after provider access and version audit.
models.access: Provider charts do not establish permission or availability of machine-readable forecast archives.
notes: The cited configuration is historical. Current grid, cycles, members, license and archive remain unverified.

models.name: LAXMI
models.purpose: Observation-trained precipitation research comparator, pending a downloadable checkpoint and exact training cutoff.
notes: September 2026 preprint describes an AIFS-CRPS graph-transformer retrained with IMERG precipitation, evaluated at approximately 0.25 degrees.
The paper's global and India tropical-storm results are not this project's measured skill. Weights, data access, license and checkpoint cutoff remain unverified.
The paper states that real-time use requires additional adaptation to operational initial conditions.

models.name: Jua EPT-2
models.purpose: Optional commercial expert; exact product and rights required.
models.data_license: Provider subscription/API terms; no blanket open-data permission recorded
notes: EPT-2 deterministic and EPT-2e ensemble are distinct products.
Wind speed/direction require an explicit documented conversion before canonical wind_uv ingestion. Rainfall entitlement/field availability remains unverified here.

models.name: WRF configured regional pipeline
models.purpose: Optional versioned regional NWP experiment with audited boundary conditions.
notes: WRF is configurable software, not a ready-to-ingest archive. Register domain, physics, model release and driving data as one reproducible pipeline.

models.name: AIFS-driven WRF pipeline
models.purpose: Optional experiment requiring boundary-field completeness and regional validation.
notes: A proposed pipeline, not a documented operational source. Compatibility, derived fields and skill are not established.
Record both AIFS and WRF versions and propagate the driving checkpoint training cutoff.

models.name: CorrDiff
models.purpose: Optional downscaling component after region-specific training and validation.
notes: Conditional regional downscaler, not an independent global forecaster.
Capability, license and domain depend on the selected checkpoint; the demonstration domain must not be assumed valid for India.

datasets.name: NOAA GFS public forecast archive
constraints: Pin model cycle and parse GRIB step metadata.
Do not assume a recent rolling mirror contains a multi-year historical archive.

datasets.name: NOAA GEFS operational forecasts
constraints: Preserve every retained member and its identity.
Operational archive completeness is unverified.

datasets.name: NOAA GEFS v12 reforecast
constraints: Daily 00 UTC: 5 members; weekly extension: 11 members.
Not interchangeable with operational GEFS or with the post-2021 GraphCast evaluation period.

datasets.name: NOAA/CIRA AIWP reforecasts
datasets.data_license: Provider states Open Data with no usage restrictions
datasets.access: Public anonymous S3; bounded listing adapter implemented
constraints: Only GraphCast has native rainfall in this archive.
Keep GFS and IFS initializations distinct; inspect object names and metadata.
Provider explicitly warns that records can be missing.

datasets.name: ECMWF IFS and AIFS open data
datasets.data_license: CC-BY-4.0 plus ECMWF Terms of Use
datasets.access: Public current product subset; historical MARS access may require registration
constraints: Verify timestamp-specific product and model cycle.
Rainfall step semantics must be decoded before canonical ingestion.

datasets.name: IMD 0.25 degree daily gauge rainfall
datasets.access: Provider download and applicable data-use terms require review
constraints: Retain the published daily accumulation window including its UTC offset; do not assume midnight UTC.
A daily total cannot verify individual six-hour intervals.
Record missing-value masks, processing version and publication/revision time.

datasets.name: NASA GPM IMERG early
datasets.access: Earthdata/PPS account may be required for selected endpoint
datasets.latency_note: Nominal provider latency is not a per-record availability timestamp.
constraints: Store Early/Late/Final and product version in observation_id or a sidecar manifest.
Integrate rainfall rates over their actual intervals; preserve quality flags and missing coverage.
Final/reprocessed data must not be used as if available at the original forecast issue time.

datasets.name: NASA GPM IMERG late
datasets.access: Earthdata/PPS account may be required for selected endpoint
datasets.latency_note: Nominal provider latency is not a per-record availability timestamp.
constraints: Store Early/Late/Final and product version in observation_id or a sidecar manifest.
Integrate rainfall rates over their actual intervals; preserve quality flags and missing coverage.
Final/reprocessed data must not be used as if available at the original forecast issue time.

datasets.name: NASA GPM IMERG final
datasets.access: Earthdata/PPS account may be required for selected endpoint
datasets.latency_note: Final release can take months; use actual release time.
constraints: Store Early/Late/Final and product version in observation_id or a sidecar manifest.
Integrate rainfall rates over their actual intervals; preserve quality flags and missing coverage.
Final/reprocessed data must not be used as if available at the original forecast issue time.

datasets.name: NOAA NCEI Integrated Surface Database
datasets.access: Public NCEI downloads; India station coverage and timestamps must be audited
constraints: Respect station QC flags and missing codes; precipitation intervals vary.
Convert meteorological wind direction and speed to u/v explicitly.
Daily extrema are not instantaneous temperatures or instantaneous gust values.

datasets.name: IMD station observations
datasets.access: Provider portal/permission and exact product terms required
constraints: Do not infer a public machine-readable archive from station charts.
Document station relocations, altitude, instrument/QC and publication time.

datasets.name: ERA5 reanalysis
datasets.access: Copernicus Climate Data Store account and dataset terms
constraints: Reanalysis is model-assisted and is not independent gauge/station ground truth.
Several AI models were trained on ERA5: holdout periods must follow their training cutoff.
Use only timestamp-available fields as features; revised analyses cannot be historical operational inputs.
